card.name: Last digit of patient counts
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually 0 or 1, that ends a multi-digit patient or group count in clinical trial results, right before a percentage or the word patients.

modes.label: Trial arm counts
modes.description: Final digit of a number of patients in a treatment or placebo group, followed by a percent in parentheses.
modes.example: 6/1,697 (0.35%) of atomoxetine patients versus 4/1,56<<0>> (0.26%) of placebo

modes.label: Study size numbers
modes.description: Final digit of the total number of patients enrolled in a study or analysis.
modes.example: In a clinical study enrolling 58<<0>> adult patients with resected NSCL
